notes: Fixed Spending insights grouping again: a store whose name sometimes has an apostrophe and sometimes doesn't (McDonald's vs MCDONALDS, O'Reilly vs OREILLY, Trader Joe's vs TRADER JOES) was still split into two places in Top places, with the apostrophe version showing a stub name like “McDonald” or “Reilly”. Both spellings now count as one store. Same fix for WAL-MART vs WALMART and 7-Eleven vs SEVEN ELEVEN — each of those now counts as one place too.
